unique_owner: Root (/root); any future implementation must be assigned to one explicit writer
audit_worktree: managed worktree on docs/family-source-audit (local path omitted)
recommended_resource_policy: One owned same-binding SQL/pool context per existing lane. Only initialization failure with confirmed reservation cleanup enters failed-clean and permits identity-guarded retry. Unconfirmed/failed cleanup quarantines that lane for this handler lifetime; retained handles are not reused, re-reserved or replaced.
config_policy: Per-request selector/readConfig validation remains. pending and ready retain their existing captured A context for valid B requests; only failed-clean compares full captured context and rejects mismatch. quarantined remains 503 for A/B without resource activity; empty has no old resource to mix.

key_anchors.meaning: three cache slots, per-request config, initialization ownership, late getter, dispatch return and broad catch
reserved client adapter/JSON binding/idempotent release, role+JSON verification and finally release
readConfig builds private config using getter; valid config change is not a keyed runtime cache
healthy 100 concurrent; one failed request then 100 retries; missing configuration

critical_scope_limits: Only source/plan artifacts were written; implementation remains unassigned until Root confirms formal topology and stage.
No wire retryable flag, provider route, lane selector, auth authority, schema or request replay change is proposed.
Successful-cache behavior and no config-keying are observed source behavior, not a newly granted hot-reload contract.
Cloud BOOT three-case results alone cannot demonstrate resource disposal, complete initialization recovery timings, real JSON binding or release acceptance.
Resource reuse is permitted only after positively confirmed reservation cleanup and exact failed-clean context comparison. Unknown cleanup is quarantined, not silently retried.
No proposal state or test case has been implemented; Root alone integrates the formal proposal.

amendment_provenance.request: Root directed plan-only clarification after independent QA review

state_specific_policy.empty: Capture current candidate context and create one flight/owned resource; fail closed for unsupported projection types/keys.
state_specific_policy.pending_A: Valid B joins A flight, never mutates A context or starts B; invalid config early-returns without cancelling A.
state_specific_policy.failed_clean_A: Only full semantic equality may start one retry reusing A pool; mismatch returns existing generic 503 without reserve/new SQL/factory and retains A.
state_specific_policy.ready_A: Valid B continues using ready A; no hot reload or mismatch-503; dispatch errors never evict A. Invalid config retains legacy early-return behavior.
state_specific_policy.quarantined_A: Any later A/B request returns 503 with zero additional reserve, SQL/pool construction, verify or runtime factory calls; other lanes unaffected. Only a separate explicit new handler lifecycle can independently attempt.

cleanup_confirmation.no_client_acquired: No application reservation to release, provided the attempt lifecycle proves no client was obtained.
cleanup_confirmation.client_acquired: Original release must normally return according to existing synchronous pool release contract; entering finally/calling release/observing rejected initialization alone is insufficient.
uncertain_conditions: cannot establish whether reservation is still held
cleanup_confirmation.uncertain_action: Persist quarantined state independently of any cleared rejected Promise; retain owned SQL/pool/context without reserve/new pool/automatic end/timer/handler recreation.
cleanup_confirmation.classification_source: Observed lifecycle ownership, never exception message matching. If final verify rejection cannot distinguish cleanup failure, do not default to failed-clean.

config_semantic_projection.primitive_equality: same type and value; distinguish null/undefined/missing; exact secret and URL values without normalization
config_semantic_projection.plain_data_objects: complete own key sets and recursively projected values, ignoring key insertion order; reject unknown fields/non-enumerable attributes/accessors/functions/unsupported containers rather than omit them
config_semantic_projection.featureAllowlist: sorted exact Set members plus explicit own non-enumerable blocked-property presence and sorted blocked Set members
config_semantic_projection.set_order: insertion order ignored, membership changes significant; newly allocated equal Sets are equal
forbidden_shortcuts: object identity or shallow Set comparison
blind structuredClone that loses custom non-enumerable blocked
config_semantic_projection.private_capture: Projection and private factory configuration copy derive from the same captured values; do not retain caller mutable containers as the snapshot.
config_semantic_projection.secrecy: No config/URL/secret/membership values or configuration/credential-derived hashes in logs, reports or receipts; only boolean equality/cleanup flags and fixed phase codes.

getter_capture_policy.scope: One new lazy per-key memoizing getter per request, installed before selectors and used by selectors, readConfig, and effective late gate capture.
getter_capture_policy.per_key: Cache first string/undefined value; do not use nullish fallback to re-read undefined; getter throws remain failures.
getter_capture_policy.after_capture: Complete context before first await/resource use; factory never reads original getter after capture.
getter_capture_policy.guarantee: same-key request consistency and no post-await re-read
getter_capture_policy.not_guaranteed: No atomic transaction or revision consistency across different environment keys; stable environment remains existing premise, no new hot reload support.

additional_proposed_cases.BR-08: failed-clean mismatch on secret, gate, review identity, allowlist-only, blocked-only or dailyCallExempt-only; equal new Sets/different insertion orders must compare equal.
additional_proposed_cases.BR-09: state-by-state valid-B/invalid-config matrix, especially ready and pending must not inherit failed-clean mismatch rejection.
additional_proposed_cases.BR-10: cleanup failure then 100 A and 100 B requests: every response 503 and reserve/SQL/verify/factory deltas all zero; other lanes healthy; old callbacks cannot clear quarantine.
additional_proposed_cases.BR-13: per-request getter key call count one including undefined across selectors/readConfig/gate; no post-await getter calls; no cross-key atomic claim; cancellation does not cancel shared initialization.

curation: Only local absolute path replaced by runtime variable and provenance link added; product policy remains proposed.
